Google Material Symbols (Rounded and Outlined)
Source: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons
Revision: 49d4db35df873165d6bd6ba09b063c7dafbac2f4
License: Apache-2.0 (material-symbols-LICENSE.txt)

Android vector resources are imported by scripts/sync-material-symbols.py.
Only the framework tint attribute is removed; all icon geometry is unchanged.

The animation icon uses the official Outlined filled/700 glyph at optical size 48.
Its source URL and SHA-256 are recorded in scripts/sync-material-symbols.py.
SVG coordinates are translated into the Android viewport without changing paths.
